description: Use only when the user says to resume (e.g. "continue 3"); the agent owning a paused slot never calls it on its own. Unpauses and messages every agent on the slot to wake it (agents re-read the page and continue). all=true resumes every paused slot.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

items.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.
